title.en: Stay on one row while resolving rural 17 kW pump or Diesel 30 when power is absent
title.zh: 选型时不要并格：没有电源时，选 17 kW 农村泵还是柴油30

description.en: Read it in the Xingtai table. Start with the 17 kW rural diesel if the line is inside 30–50 m horizontal, 10–30 m vertical and 5–8 m³/h. Taken from the printed row: Move to Diesel 30 when the off-grid job needs 15 m³/h and 60 m / 180 m. Keep this cell as published. Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai prints both for sites without stable grid power. The neighbouring machine is not this sentence. The house pump is 800 kg with aggregate 1–3 cm. Read it in the Xingtai table. Diesel 30 is 2000 kg, with a 3 cm maximum cell and a 1 cm note in the introduction.
description.zh: 按邢台表上的原文理解：管路在水平 30–50 m、垂直 10–30 m、5–8 m³/h 内，从 17 kW 农村柴油泵开始。无电网作业需要 15 m³/h 和 60 m / 180 m 时，再看柴油30。邢台河北品锦机械把两台都印给电网不便的工地。住宅泵是 800 kg，骨料 1–3 cm。柴油30是 2000 kg，最大骨料格 3 cm，产品介绍里还有 1 cm 的说明。

h1.zh: 选型时不要并格：没有电源时，选 17 kW 农村泵还是柴油30

Taken from the printed row: Move to Diesel 30 when the off-grid job needs 15 m³/h and 60 m / 180 m. Keep this cell as published. Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai prints both for sites without stable grid power. The neighbouring machine is not this sentence. The house pump is 800 kg with aggregate 1–3 cm. Read it in the Xingtai table. Diesel 30 is 2000 kg, with a 3 cm maximum cell and a 1 cm note in the introduction.
directAnswer.zh: 按邢台表上的原文理解：管路在水平 30–50 m、垂直 10–30 m、5–8 m³/h 内，从 17 kW 农村柴油泵开始。无电网作业需要 15 m³/h 和 60 m / 180 m 时，再看柴油30。邢台河北品锦机械把两台都印给电网不便的工地。住宅泵是 800 kg，骨料 1–3 cm。柴油30是 2000 kg，最大骨料格 3 cm，产品介绍里还有 1 cm 的说明。

body.en: The section shape comes from “History” in “Two-stroke engine”. The sentences are a restatement of the catalogue, not of that article. Read it in the Xingtai table. 17 kW, 5–8 m³/h and 30–50 m horizontal is the house pump. Taken from the printed row: The house pump is 800 kg with aggregate 1–3 cm. Keep this cell as published. If a 15 kW supply exists, Electric 15 prints the longer 60–80 m horizontal and 15–20 m vertical at 450 kg. The neighbouring machine is not this sentence. Use /contact, the on-site WhatsApp button, PinjinHebei@Outlook.com or 19912003025. Read it in the Xingtai table. Diesel 30 prints 20 MPa. Image from the source page: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Two-stroke_engine
body.zh: 这一节的形状来自《Two-stroke engine》的“沿革”。文字是目录的转述，不是那篇文章的原文。按邢台表上的原文理解：17 kW、5–8 m³/h、水平 30–50 m 是住宅泵。柴油30是 56 kW、15 m³/h、60 m / 180 m、2000 kg。目录里已经写着：请把配合比、最大石子或粒径、需要的输送量、量到的水平与垂直管路，以及现场是电网还是必须用柴油，发给邢台的河北品锦机械。途径是 /contact、站内 WhatsApp、PinjinHebei@Outlook.com 或 19912003025。不要附上目录里没有的项目名称、国家工程或日浇筑方量。图来自来源页面：https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Two-stroke_engine

body.en: “Two-stroke engine” breaks its subject at “Emissions”. Here the same break only holds the cells this model already prints. Taken from the printed row: Diesel 30 is 56 kW, 15 m³/h and 60 m / 180 m at 2000 kg. Keep this cell as published. Diesel 30 is 2000 kg, with a 3 cm maximum cell and a 1 cm note in the introduction. The neighbouring machine is not this sentence. Absence of that supply is why the 17 kW diesel exists. Do not attach a project name, a country job or a daily volume the catalogue leaves that cell blank for. Taken from the printed row: No.
body.zh: 《Two-stroke engine》在“排放”处把题目拆开。这里这一段只放这台机器已经印出的格子。管路在水平 30–50 m、垂直 10–30 m、5–8 m³/h 内，从 17 kW 农村柴油泵开始。无电网作业需要 15 m³/h 和 60 m / 180 m 时，再看柴油30。河北品锦机械（邢台）把两台都印给电网不便的工地。住宅泵是 800 kg，骨料 1–3 cm。柴油30是 2000 kg，最大骨料格 3 cm，产品介绍里还有 1 cm 的说明。这一格照已印出的读：农村泵印 0.2 m³。柴油30印 0.3 m³。

body.en: Borrow “Applications” from “Two-stroke engine” as the skeleton, and fill it with the printed window for this page. Keep this cell as published. Start with the 17 kW rural diesel if the line is inside 30–50 m horizontal, 10–30 m vertical and 5–8 m³/h. The neighbouring machine is not this sentence. One product is called the rural self-built house diesel pump. Read it in the Xingtai table. Presence of that supply is why you should not stay on diesel out of habit. Taken from the printed row: The rural pump prints 0.2 m³. Keep this cell as published. The compact diesel page is the 17 kW rural pump.
body.zh: 把《Two-stroke engine》的“用途”借来当骨架，里面填的是本页这一格已经印出的窗口。这一格照已印出的读：一台的产品名就是农村自建房柴油混凝土泵。另一台是柴油30，用于农村与基建的拖泵。管路对得上住宅泵时去买拖泵，会多出重量和一张你可能不需要的距离表。旁边那一台不在这句话里。农村泵印 15 MPa。柴油30印 20 MPa。

body.en: The reference page “Two-stroke engine” uses “Designs” as one of its own divisions. What follows is the Xingtai row, said again in different words. The neighbouring machine is not this sentence. Move to Diesel 30 when the off-grid job needs 15 m³/h and 60 m / 180 m. Read it in the Xingtai table. The other is Diesel 30, a trailer for rural and infrastructure placement. Taken from the printed row: Say which distance pair you measured: 30–50 m or 60 m / 180 m. Keep this cell as published. Diesel 30 prints 0.3 m³. The neighbouring machine is not this sentence. The trailer series published here starts at Diesel 30.
body.zh: 来源页《Two-stroke engine》用“方案”划分这一节。后面是邢台目录里已有内容，换一种说法写下。旁边那一台不在这句话里。如果有 15 kW 电源，电动15印了更长的水平 60–80 m 和垂直 15–20 m，重量 450 kg。没有这路电源，才有 17 kW 柴油泵。有这路电源时，不要习惯性留在柴油上。按邢台表上的原文理解：没有。紧凑柴油页是 17 kW 农村泵。这里公布的拖式系列从柴油30开始。

body.en: “Power-valve systems” is an outline label from “Two-stroke engine”. That label does not add a figure to the printed row. Read it in the Xingtai table. Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai prints both for sites without stable grid power. Taken from the printed row: Buying the trailer for a line that fits the house pump adds weight and a different distance table you may not need. Keep this cell as published. Send Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai the mix, the largest stone or particle, the output you need, the horizontal and vertical pipe you measured, and whether the site has grid voltage or must use diesel. The neighbouring machine is not this sentence. The rural pump prints 15 MPa. Headings already printed: Electric 15 remains the grid alternative at this size
body.zh: “功率阀系统”是《Two-stroke engine》大纲上的标题。这个标题不给已印出的行增加数字。按邢台表上的原文理解：请说明你量到的是哪一对距离：30–50 m，还是 60 m / 180 m。已印出的标题：这一档有电网时的替代仍是电动15

question.en: “History” does not change the check: Which hopper is smaller?
question.zh: “沿革”不改这一问：哪个料斗更小？

answer.en: Read it in the Xingtai table. The rural pump prints 0.2 m³. Diesel 30 prints 0.3 m³.
answer.zh: 按邢台表上的原文理解：农村泵印 0.2 m³。柴油30印 0.3 m³。

question.en: Do both print 15 MPa, once the outline says “Emissions”?
question.zh: 大纲写着“排放”时，两台都印 15 MPa 吗？

answer.en: Taken from the printed row: The rural pump prints 15 MPa. Diesel 30 prints 20 MPa.
answer.zh: 目录里已经写着：农村泵印 15 MPa。柴油30印 20 MPa。

question.en: Under “Applications”, is there a Diesel 20 page?
question.zh: 在“用途”这一节里，有柴油20页面吗？

answer.en: Keep this cell as published. No. The compact diesel page is the 17 kW rural pump. The trailer series published here starts at Diesel 30.
answer.zh: 这一格照已印出的读：没有。紧凑柴油页是 17 kW 农村泵。这里公布的拖式系列从柴油30开始。
